assertions.name: plancherel_content_is_palindromic_bar_even_shape_sum
assertions.source: C_n^all = Σ_λ (f^λ)² q^content(λ) (= all-perm enumeration, palindromic, C(1)=n!, first moment 0); same anti-invariant involution as the involution object, so the Δ_ω bar-even rigidity is weight-independent. Both q-Gevrey, → ln q_0.

description: Lever-1 item 3 (twist-completion): squared-Plancherel sibling of the W12 content-monomial separation. The all-permutation content-only object is the closed shape sum C_n^all(q) = Σ_λ (f^λ)² q^content(λ) (RSK: #{w: shape λ} = (f^λ)²) — verified = direct all-permutation enumeration (n≤7), palindromic (Q2), C_n^all(1)=n! (Q3), and first moment Σ(f^λ)²·content = 0 (Q4, the bar-even O((q-1)^2) Δ_ω rigidity). Q2+Q4 are the SAME anti-invariant-involution facts proved generally in QOU/Common/AntiInvolutionPalindrome.lean — weight (f^λ)² is conjugation-invariant, so the abstract lemma covers the whole Plancherel measure with no new Lean; the Δ_ω rigidity is a weight-independent property of the content sector. Comparison: q=1 limits differ (n! vs I(n)); both q-Gevrey with deg = n(n-1)/2 and the same ln q_0 asymptote; the larger base mass n! >> I(n) keeps r_all ABOVE r_inv at finite n (slower convergence to ln q_0), correcting an initial 'balanced-shape favouring' guess. Exact sympy + 50-dps mpmath; no fit; no wiring; EXPLORATORY.
